search.archive_screening: The two D3.3 late-horizon result archives were listed read-only without extraction; neither contains a filename matching Simulation1/bootstrap/initial-world/FULL_A1/210Ma/Pangaea/supercontinent. Other compressed files were screened by location/name and are provider/PRE5 payload archives, RNG-state fixtures, or tool dependencies, not plausible pre-import bootstrap sources.
search.candidate_simulation1_filename_or_text_m: No exact Simulation1/bootstrap/A1-writer source was found. The v0.1-v0.5.5F copies do contain early HYBRID-1 tectonic/geology code and outputs, adjudicated separately below.

related_preimport_worldsim_prototype.project: ARCANA World Simulator v0.1 / World 1 / HYBRID-1

generator.finding: build_hybrid1() hard-codes plate polygons and age-keyed poses; its docstring calls the 210 Ma geometry a schematic Pangea. This generates the HYBRID-1 scenario, not FULL_A1_REFERENCE_210_0Ma.npz. No external paleogeographic source or rotation-model binding is declared here.

runner.finding: Invokes build_hybrid1(seed), then TectonicSimulator, and exports age-specific GeoJSON/figures, timeline, and audit. It consumes its in-code HYBRID-1 scenario; it does not read the A1 NPZ or an identified Simulation1 initial-state package.

210ma_execution_output.finding: HYBRID-1 GeoJSON snapshot at age_ma=210.0; direct prototype output, not identified as the original Simulation1 run artifact.

related_preimport_worldsim_prototype.topography_evidence: v0.1 README says mountain building is represented only as events, not elevation; v0.3 docs/config add geological/elevation fields and explicitly scope the produced geology to 0 Ma. This establishes later introduction in this prototype lineage, not the original Simulation1 topography contract.
related_preimport_worldsim_prototype.deep_evidence: No fundamental Deep initial field/law is present in v0.1-v0.4 bootstrap sources found. v0.5.5B/C later expose Deep-related georesource/accessibility/stability/hazard fields; these do not recover a Simulation1 Deep initializer.
related_preimport_worldsim_prototype.planet_and_seed_evidence: v0.1 config/runner records seed 917231, but initial geometry is hard-coded and no RNG call constructs it; seed's historical Simulation1 role is unproven. A 6371 km default in v0.1 geometry is used for great-circle distance, not bound as the original Simulation1 planet-radius authority. Gravity, spin/day, tilt/orbit, atmosphere, sea-level datum, and ocean fraction are not recovered as Simulation1 settings.

evidence.r1_to_r3_convergence: Later R1-R3 artifacts/configurations also use a 210 Ma start; they support the chosen design era but do not authenticate the missing original Simulation1 bootstrap.

recovery.qualification: This status concerns the exact identity/provenance chain for Simulation1. A direct early HYBRID-1 source/config/runner/output survives, but no source authority links it to the Simulation1 identity or to the A1 NPZ producer/consumer.

adjudication.reason: The fixed authorial requirement calls for approximately the Simulation1 era; the early direct HYBRID-1 prototype explicitly begins with schematic Pangea at 210 Ma; A1's first coordinate is 210 Ma; and later R1-R3 starts converge on 210 Ma within the frozen world-history architecture. Together these justify deliberate R6 re-adoption of 210 Ma as design t0, without claiming it was the original Simulation1 canonical t0.
adjudication.remaining_unchecked_concrete_source: none found in the bounded accessible Arcana project locations; no pre-import archive named or indexed as the missing Simulation1 source remains unchecked.
